# kits/yeti: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

The Yeti kit (catalog and tags culture khaayken): the Khaayken of the High Country on the north-western Outer Wall, Inuit-derived catenary domes of pycrete or dry slab stone, half-sunk, joined by half-buried tunnels, austere outside and rich inside (PLAN.md; section 4 the heat, air and cold rules). So far Y1 to Y4 (the state, trades, stores, stock and war added): the Scyvoi engine vendored (10-core.js on core/rand); the toolkit (catenary and corbelled shells, spiral courses, ribs, the slump, the cold-trap entry, the wall layers and the frost rule); the mass heater; the pycrete dome, the travel dome and the stone house in three seasons; the family cluster; the tunnels in three sections and a covered-way network on core/city (KCITY.covered); the sheet's ground holed for sunk floors. Verified: build.py, verify.py --assert. Read PLAN.md

Docs: `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `PLAN.md`, `PORT.md`, `README.md`

Built output (never open it; edit `src/` and rebuild): `dist/yeti.html`

Build: `cd kits/yeti && python3 build.py`. Fragments are concatenated in filename order.
Fragments marked **big** are over 30 KB: find the section below and read only that range.
